name: Yuunagi-sou no S-kyuu no Kanojo-tachi 2
storyline:
For a long time, the 2nd floor of Yuunagi-sou had been vacant.

This peculiar apartment is reserved for privileged S-class individuals, so a few empty rooms were no surprise.

However――.

As if drawn to our protagonist, new tenants begin to arrive one after another.

An annoying former kouhai.
An overly anxious school teacher.
A studious-looking closet pervert examinee.
An easily aroused aspiring seiyuu.

Thus, the entire 2nd floor is occupied, and Yuunagi-sou is getting livelier.
With the 2nd floor as the backdrop, a pure~lewd life begins once again......❤️
